The listings above are apartment-style condos in Cloverdale, a City of Surrey community. Paragon, the MLS® system local REALTORS® use, treats Cloverdale as a Surrey sub-area that includes both Clayton and the historic town centre. You'll see every price here. If you want a single price band, see

Cloverdale is in the City of Surrey, so Surrey's bylaws and plans apply, not Langley's, even on streets close to the border. Condo buildings sit near the town centre and in Clayton on the north side. To learn the area street by street, read my

Near Highway 10 and 176 Street you're close to the Cloverdale Recreation Centre (6188 176 Street), the Cloverdale Library on 176A Street, and the Museum of Surrey. The Cloverdale Fairgrounds host the Cloverdale Rodeo and Country Fair on the May long weekend.

On the north side, the Clayton Community Centre at 7155 187A Street has a gym, a fitness centre and a library in one building. Two Surrey Langley SkyTrain stations are being built on Fraser Highway, at 184 Street and at 190 Street.

Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary serves the town centre area, and Clayton Heights Secondary and École Salish Secondary are in Clayton. Check any address in the School Locator. A new Surrey hospital and BC Cancer Centre is under construction in Cloverdale, with opening targeted for 2030, and the City is updating the Town Centre Plan around it. My

blocks.text: What you own when you buy a condo

parts.t: A Cloverdale condo is a strata lot. You hold title to your unit and share the common property, like the roof, halls, parkade and grounds, with the other owners through the strata corporation. Its elected council sets the fees and makes the bylaws. Some spaces, like a patio or a parking stall, may be limited common property for one unit only. The strata plan shows what comes with yours.

Ask for the Form B: Information Certificate early. The Province says the strata has to provide it within 7 days of a request from an owner, a buyer or their agent. It shows the fee, any arrears, approved special levies and the contingency reserve fund, with the budget, rules and the latest depreciation report attached. Newer Form Bs also summarize the strata's insurance and electrical planning reports.

Any BC strata with five or more lots needs a depreciation report on a five-year cycle. It forecasts 30 years of repairs and replacements. In an older town-centre low-rise, look at what it says about the roof, windows and building envelope. In a newer Clayton building, check the parkade membrane and mechanical systems.

Owners and buyers can ask the strata for records such as council meeting minutes and annual general meeting minutes. Minutes often show what the building has been talking about before it turns into a special levy. Look for repeated mentions of leaks, insurance claims, elevator work or envelope repairs.

blocks.text: Before you buy a Cloverdale condo

parts.t: Go through the whole Form B package, including the budget and depreciation report.
Get the bylaws, the rules and two years of minutes.
Find your unit, stall and locker on the strata plan.
Ask about insurance deductibles, since owners can be responsible for part of a claim.
Check the pet bylaws before you write an offer.

blocks.text: Is a Cloverdale condo a strata?

parts.t: Yes. You own your unit as a strata lot and share the common property with the other owners.
Yes. Paragon lists Clayton under the Cloverdale sub-area, and it's part of the City of Surrey's Cloverdale community.
